statements.statement: The special education reserve fund being established (not yet funded) is capped by law at 2% of net school spending.
A board member noted out-of-district special education placements can cost well over a million dollars, prompting discussion of the reserve fund's limits.
The school committee discussed pursuing additional Chapter 70 funding but decided not to put forward a warrant article for it.
Free cash is expected to be certified by November 18, though possibly not before the warrant goes to print; if uncertified, old capital appropriations would cover one-time items instead.

warnings.condition: if the district intentionally underfunded that line, relying on the reserve fund instead
warnings.prediction: the district would most likely run into difficulties and face substantial costs
